stance_rationale: STR_1725 draft_C does not validate the emitted alpha vector; reported rank_IC and Harvey evidence are inflated by mean(abs(IC)) single-factor diagnostics, while universe/liquidity filters and C15 loader discipline are not enforced. This is not a deployable or graduation-eligible alpha package.

harvey_t.pass_count_basis: 2/4 PIT-aligned component factors exceed t>3; no required 5-spec Harvey matrix was produced

time_series_alpha_audit.comment: overnight_C alpha_scores is multi-date, but it is sparse top-pick rows only, uses sig_date/alpha_z rather than required Date/Ticker/score schema, and the mandated stage A/B artifacts are stale non-C packages with 83/80 dates.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: Final v3 construction ranks ic_sign(sig_date) * Raw_Value, not Z_Score_Aligned only; this violates the C13 implementation mandate even if no NEGATE_FACTORS literal appears.
ic_sign_at uses factor_ic_monthly Usable_Date <= sig_date for direction inference, but this does not cure the invalid abs(IC) diagnostics.
scripts/overnight_C directly read .cache/factor_db/factor_db_YYYYMM.parquet and factor_ic_monthly.parquet; the draft rationalizes this as connector semantics replicated.
No regime or overlay component is present in STR_1725 draft_C.
Microstructure factors are price/volume derived, not financial-statement factors.

critical_concerns.description: Reported rank_ic=0.0807 and Harvey t=11.529 are based on mean(abs(IC)) and abs-based aligned t-statistics, not realized composite alpha IC. A PIT-aligned recomputation gives composite proxy mean IC about 0.0217, below the 0.04 gate. [PIT-C12, AX-002, RF-A6]

Universe and liquidity mandates are not enforced: audit of overnight_C selected rows found 2108/3705 below 20d TV 2e8 won and 2334/3323 rows outside KOSPI200/KOSDAQ150 flags; final 2023-11-30 names include multiple zero or sub-2e8 TV names. [PIT-C10, RF-A5, L-484]

C15 is violated by direct parquet loading of factor_db monthly files and factor_ic_monthly while claiming load_month_factors semantics were replicated. Process equivalence is not the charter requirement. [PIT-C15, AX-002]
Final construction abandoned Z_Score_Aligned-only discipline and ranks ic_sign * Raw_Value; that is a manual direction-alignment path outside the mandated C13 surface. [PIT-C13, AX-002]

RF-A3 is triggered on actual PIT-aligned composite proxy: recent 3Y ICIR is about 0.652 versus full 0.286, a 2.28x ratio. The package flags RF-A3 but still reports graduation-style PASS metrics. [RF-A3, AX-002]

AX-007 multi-sleeve exception is asserted but weakly implemented: final 20 names have sleeves_in=1 for every name, and no sleeve weights or optimizer constraints prove multi-sleeve portfolio behavior. [AX-007, L-484]

No STR_1725 challenge_note, risk_package, optimization_package, weights.csv, or covariance.parquet exists; covariance PSD/condition and schedule checks requested by the task cannot be performed. [AX-008, RF-A7]

supporting_arguments: overnight_C alpha_scores has 191 monthly sig_dates from 2008-01-31 to 2023-11-30 and no future sig_date.
Pairwise factor correlation max_abs_cor=0.4032 is below the 0.5 orthogonality threshold.
Raw/PIT direction signs are stable across the three broad subperiods, but that does not offset the rank_IC, liquidity, C13, and C15 failures.

Whether actual composite alpha_z vs forward return rank_IC clears 0.04 after KOSPI200/KOSDAQ150 and PIT t-1 20d TV >= 2e8 filters.
Whether DSR remains above 0.50 using the true Factor DB/method-search denominator, not candidates_tried=4.
Whether the sparse top-pick alpha_scores schema is acceptable to downstream Risk/Optimizer contracts.
weakest_assumption: The weakest claim is that average absolute single-factor IC can certify the rank-based 4x5 sleeve alpha vector.
rebuttal_required: Provide actual Date x Ticker x score composite IC diagnostics from alpha_scores versus forward 1M returns.
Rebuild with load_month_factors() only and Z_Score_Aligned only, or file an explicit infeasibility report.
Apply PIT t-1 liquidity and universe filters before selection and re-report IC, top20, turnover, and monotonicity.
Produce corrected DSR and 5-spec Harvey evidence with the full method-search denominator.
Produce STR_1725-specific challenge_note and artifact lineage, or mark missing weights/covariance/risk/optimizer artifacts as blockers.

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: The external issue is not just missing downstream artifacts; the alpha evidence itself is not measuring the emitted STR_1725 portfolio signal and fails hard constraints when independently audited.
